# Performance History by Commit

Every commit of `root` with a different compiler, runtime or third-party state, built and benchmarked on its own with the short benchmark set (`benchmarks/history_commits.py`, 3 runs, mean ± standard deviation). Commits that only change documentation, tests, CI or the wiki share the result of the commit before. Only rows where a number changed (📈 better, 📉 worse; at least 3% and over two standard deviations of the difference to the row above) are listed, builds that do not compile or do not run are left out (0 of 3 states). The full results are in `commits/` of the `performance-history` branch. The machine is the Vulkan on llvmpipe one of [Performance History](Performance-History). Last updated 2026-10-28.
